C-PORTABLE-PORTAL.IntentSummary: Implement the user-approved on-demand folder export as a separate packaging step, then test the real exported files.

T-001.Title: Export explicit file navigation and bundled search with portable interactions.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Source HTML remains unchanged; the CLI writes a self-contained folder only when invoked.

T-002.Title: Exercise the exported package through file URLs and document its use.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All pages open and representative search, language, theme, diagrams, font and copy interactions pass in Chromium; no HTTP resource requests occur.

T-003.Title: Record the export module and verification in GRACE.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Graph and verification route the portable export separately from HTTP publication.
